title: Neurodegeneration: 2023 update.
one_liner_zh: 该文是神经退行性疾病病理学年度综述，虽提及TDP-43等DNA结合蛋白，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This paper reviews ten highly impactful studies published in the previous year selected by the author from the neurodegenerative neuropathology literature. As in previous years, the focus is to highlight human tissue-based experimentation most relevant to neuropathologists. A concerted effort was made to balance the selected studies across disease categories, approaches, and methodologies to capture the breadth of the research landscape. Studies include an integrated proteomic and transcriptomic study of Alzheimer disease (AD) and new consensus diagnostic neuropathological criteria for progressive supranuclear palsy. A number of studies looking at TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) are highlighted. One examined interaction between AD and limbic age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy (LATE) and yet another demonstrated how TDP-43 represses cryptic exon inclusion in UNC13A, suggesting a novel pathogenic mechanism. Most surprisingly, three cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) studies showed that TMEM106B filaments form the core of TDP-43-positive inclusions. Cryo-EM revealed a prion protein amyloid structure from aggregates in Gerstmann-Straussler-Scheinker disease. There was an elegant functional genomic study cataloging microglial gene expression in the human brain. A study shed light on how APOE influences chronic traumatic encephalopathy. A pathoanatomical study tested the dual hit hypothesis of Lewy body progression throughout the nervous system. And finally, deep learning continues to show its promise with application of a weakly supervised multiple instance learning paradigm to assess aging post-mortem brains.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了作者从神经退行性神经病理学文献中选出的上一年度十项高影响力研究。与前几年一样，重点在于突出与神经病理学家最相关的人体组织实验。作者努力在疾病类别、方法和技术手段之间平衡所选研究，以捕捉研究领域的广度。研究包括一项关于阿尔茨海默病（AD）的整合蛋白质组学和转录组学研究，以及进行性核上性麻痹的新共识诊断神经病理学标准。若干聚焦于TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）的研究被重点介绍。其中一项研究了AD与边缘系统年龄相关TDP-43脑病（LATE）之间的相互作用，另一项则展示了TDP-43如何抑制UNC13A中的隐蔽外显子包含，提示了一种新的致病机制。最令人惊讶的是，三项冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）研究表明，TMEM106B丝状体构成了TDP-43阳性包涵体的核心。冷冻电镜还揭示了格斯特曼-斯特劳斯勒-申克病中聚集物形成的朊蛋白淀粉样结构。有一项优雅的功能基因组学研究，对人类大脑中的小胶质细胞基因表达进行了编目。一项研究阐明了APOE如何影响慢性创伤性脑病。一项病理解剖学研究检验了路易体在神经系统中进展的双重打击假说。最后，深度学习继续展现其潜力，通过应用弱监督多实例学习范式来评估衰老的死后大脑。
